correctness.rationale: Cyclic arc spacings are Dirichlet(1,1,1), so ordered triangle half-angles X,Y,Z have constant coordinate density 8/pi^2 on X+Y+Z=pi/2 and R=4sin Xsin Ysin Z. At fixed X=x the difference coordinate has unit Jacobian and the admissible interval yields the arccos integral with exact roots. Three corner neighborhoods give each area t/4 log(1/t) plus O(t); other edge bands are O(t). The equilateral maximum Hessian is 2(u^2+uv+v^2), and the ellipse area gives the upper-tail coefficient. Independent quadrature at 5 thresholds agrees with a two-dimensional grid survival at t=1/4 (0.406006 vs 0.405971), and near-maximum ratio 1.470259 vs exact 1.470210. These numerical checks do not replace asymptotic proofs.
